tools.name: _find_cfbf_template
tools.doc: Finds an existing authentic Cscape CFBF (.csp) file to use as base template.

tools.name: cscape_launch_ide
tools.doc: Launches Cscape.exe, auto-dismisses splash modal, and enters IEC 61131 mode.

tools.name: cscape_new_iec_project
tools.doc: Creates a new Horner Cscape IEC 61131-3 project (pure ST, no ladder).

tools.name: cscape_open_project
tools.doc: Opens and verifies a Horner Cscape project file (.csp / .cpj).

tools.name: cscape_insert_st
tools.doc: Injects Structured Text POU into Cscape with syntax & ladder-rejection checks.

tools.name: cscape_compile
tools.doc: Triggers live compilation via ID_PROGRAM_ERRORCHECK (32826 / Ctrl+F7).

tools.name: cscape_get_build_output
tools.doc: Retrieves compilation logs, diagnostics, and output window content.

tools.name: cscape_import_variables
tools.doc: Imports Horner OCS variables from CSV or XML database export.

tools.name: cscape_export_variables
tools.doc: Exports Horner OCS variables to CSV or XML database format.

tools.name: cscape_run_simulation
tools.doc: Runs software simulation of Horner OCS registers (%R, %M, %T, %AI, %AQ, %I, %Q, %S).

tools.name: cscape_create_project
tools.doc: Initializes a new Horner Cscape IEC 61131-3 project.

tools.name: cscape_add_st_pou
tools.doc: Adds or updates an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text POU.

tools.name: cscape_validate_st
tools.doc: Validates IEC 61131-3 Structured Text code syntax and rejects ladder artifacts.

tools.name: cscape_compile_project
tools.doc: Compiles all Structured Text POUs in a project headlessly.

tools.name: cscape_get_diagnostics
tools.doc: Retrieves compilation logs and health diagnostics for a project.

tools.name: cscape_simulate_pou
tools.doc: Simulates IEC 61131-3 Structured Text logic cycles in software via CscapeSimulator.

tools.name: cscape_export_project
tools.doc: Exports project in specified format (csp, cpj, json, st, xml). Legacy k5p exports are quarantined.

tools.name: register_tools
tools.doc: Registers all real Cscape 10.2 MCP tools and convenience wrappers on MCPServer.
